principle: Unlawful material is refused BEFORE it can become registrable. The review's central criticism was that refusal happened only at the M3 evaluator, so material was authorable, registerable and positively evaluable before failing closed.

refusals.before: an open schema (additional_fields true) with a person-state role and an unrelated schema_ref was accepted by author_result_contract_binding, accepted by author_governed_rule, and registered
refusals.after: refused at author_result_contract_binding by the same node validator, and independently refused at registry build

refusals.before: schema_ref content_hash could be unrelated to the schema
refusals.after: schema_ref is recomputed from the schema material and required to equal it exactly

refusals.before: person-state semantic roles were refused only by author_closed_result_schema
refusals.after: refused on the binding path, the rule path and the registry path

refusals.before: a rule with participant_roles (ACTOR_DESIRE, ACTOR_BELIEF) registered and evaluated SUPPORTED, with the positive object carrying those roles
refusals.after: refused on actor-semantic tokens, covering the whole semantic class rather than two probed labels

refusals.before: a schema whose enum was (DOMINATION, HEGEMONY, CAPITAL, PRESSURE_COUPLING) registered and evaluated SUPPORTED with payload relation_kind DOMINATION
refusals.after: every blocked strong noun is refused in any enum value or exact-ref kind

refusals.before: the three TD_R03 §5 non-inferable premises were the authorable relation kinds
refusals.after: all three are refused in any authorable relation-kind enum

refusals.before: a number leaf literally named pressure_magnitude under OBJECTIVE_MEASUREMENT was accepted
refusals.after: number and integer leaves are refused outright, with the numeric-formula-ref requirement cited

refusals.before: a hand-built GovernedRule with semantic_family V556_INVENTED_FAMILY registered and populated_families reported it
refusals.after: registry build refuses any non-frozen family, in addition to the existing rule-author and M3 checks

refusals.before: the previous court registered two IDENTICAL rules, tripping the duplicate-KEY branch while claiming to prove the per-family branch
refusals.after: the repaired court builds two rules with DISTINCT rule keys and asserts the keys differ, so the family branch is genuinely exercised; one rule alone still builds

refusals.before: OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED was accepted by author_result_contract_binding but unsatisfiable, because ADMITTED_OBJECTIVE_ROLES excluded OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEX
refusals.after: withdrawn from the tranche with a stated reason, so there is no dead accepted mode

refusals.before: material was live dicts inside a frozen dataclass; a deep mutation registered and was caught only at evaluation
refusals.after: material is deep-frozen so mutation raises TypeError, and registry build recomputes rule_content_hash and the binding hash

refusals.before: multiplicity_policy was only _text-checked, so WHATEVER_I_LIKE authored successfully
refusals.after: frozen to the named MULTIPLICITY_POLICIES vocabulary

refusals.before: payload endpoint refs were free-floating exact refs
refusals.after: a payload route ref not among the governed participants' v555 route identities is refused, and the rule cardinality floor and maximum are enforced

refusals.before: a binding naming a different rule id/version was not checked
refusals.after: author_governed_rule refuses a contract bound to a different rule id/version
